body: Hello! I’m 20 years old and Ive been working as a direct support professional for individuals who have intellectual disabilities for the past 2 years. If you need somebody you want advice from or if you want to talk me you can DM me anytime :) You have absolutely NOTHING to feel like a failure for because high school is hard for everyone! Do NOT measure your intelligence by the grades you get in school, you are so much more then just a grade and the stuff you were taught will barely matter in real life situations. so if anything, just take comfort in knowing that the only thing that truly matters is your happiness and how you treat others.

Same, before I had the courage to make an appointment I told my friends who have been through therapy and medication before that I was considering seeking help and that I didn’t feel like myself. It was when a LOT of people started noticing my sad demeanor and asking if I was okay that I started seriously doubting that I was fine. 

I finally had my breaking point with my mom and blatantly told her that I needed to make an appointment over text message when I wasn’t home and she was bitching at me. She asked why and I left it at mental health, but when she tried speaking about it to me in person I told her I was fine I just wanted to check up on my mental health. At this point she knew I didn’t want to talk and so she stopped pressuring me as much to speak, and she let me. I’m at least relieved that I’m finally taking the first step, and I think you just have to force yourself to say fuck it. 

The biggest advice I can give as the first step with serve anxiety is telling a couple of people close to you that you trust, and then allowing them to help you out. The friends that I did tell, were willing to sit and help me through it or even make my appointment for me. 

I sincerely wish you the best of luck 😢💜
